algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 (key = hex-decoded serverSeed); backward in-place Fisher-Yates over 416 cards; deal PDPD; optimal basic strategy S17/DAS/SPA1/no-resplit/dealer-peek; blackjack 3:2

baseGame.sdPerRoundNote: Measured per-round SD of the per-initial-bet loss. standardError/gate use the constant 1.15 (this value rounded up).
baseGame.method: Fair-shuffle consistency simulation for the declared rules and strategy. Fresh-run estimates vary with Monte Carlo sampling error. Results use per-initial-bet and per-total-wager conventions; the verifier compares the estimates with the exact finite eight-deck model. Pass 1 separately checks first-card rank uniformity and the specified serial statistics of blackjackShoe.
baseGame.note: Finite 8-deck RTP under optimal basic strategy (S17/DAS/SPA1/no-resplit/peek, blackjack 3:2). Per initial bet the finite figure sits just above the analytical infinite-deck limit, as card removal predicts.

realShoeConsistency.note: RTP (per initial bet) over the actual blackjackShoe RNG algorithm, held against the exact 8-deck TD solve at the stated σ (scored Step 18). Fewer rounds than Pass 0 (the real shoe is HMAC-hashed per card), so the Monte-Carlo error is wider; baseGame is the fair-shuffle consistency estimate.

exactFiguresSource: outputs/exact-rtp.json (regenerate with `npm run rtp`) — deterministic exact 8-deck EV of record: finite-8 TD headline (anchored to the tiny-shoe oracle + Wizard of Odds), finite-8 CD is a demoted internal diagnostic (cdPeekIsApproximate, never published), finite-1 deck-sensitivity, infinite-deck regression value, card-removal lift, WoO anchor.

pass1_fresh_seeds.description: One server/client seed pair, both halves derived from this run's recorded master seed, drives a 1,000,000-nonce stream of the reference blackjackShoe algorithm. The retained results cover first-card rank uniformity (df=12), lag-1 correlation and the runs test. These are specified statistical checks; the finite eight-deck RTP is evaluated separately by the deterministic model and a simulation consistency check. The seed pair is RETAINED below, so this experiment can be replayed exactly (npx ts-node src/deep-replay.ts).

pass2_casino_seeds.description: Casino seeds (revealed serverSeeds), each replayed over nonces 0..9,999 with its epoch client seed. PRIMARY (since 2026-09-24): the MONEY statistic — every nonce played to settlement under the declared basic strategy, net return summed per 50-round window; the served window (nonces 0..49, the captured range) is ranked against the seed's own 199 later windows (one-sided, low return flags) and pooled over all seeds against the exact 8-deck mean. SECONDARY: first-card rank uniformity over the served window vs a parametric bootstrap null, with the late window as control. Neither is the primary cherry-pick defence, which is the client-seed-after-commitment mitigation (see operator-trust-analysis.md#residual-trust-seed-selection-cherry-picking).
pass2_casino_seeds.nullFormat: IEEE-754 float64 little-endian, GENERATION order (index r = replicate r), one value per bootstrap replicate
pass2_casino_seeds.pValueRule: (count(null statistic >= observed statistic) + 1) / (bootstrapReps + 1), evaluated on a sorted copy of the retained nulls

money.rule: per seed p = (1 + #{later windows with net <= served window net}) / windows, flagged at p <= alpha; family: flagged seeds > gate (binomial upper tail at familyAlpha) FLAGs; pooled z = (sum of served-window net - exact mean) / (sdPerRound * sqrt(served rounds)) < -zGate FLAGs. Fixed in src/config.ts before the statistic was first computed (2026-09-24). Since 2026-09-25 sdPerRound is the EXACT per-round SD (outputs/exact-rtp.json finite8TDMoments.sd), not a measured SD rounded up.
money.strategy: declared basic strategy (src/strategy.ts) via src/round-engine.ts settleShoe
